economy.summary: His campaign platform calls for raising Pennsylvania's minimum wage from $7.25 to $15.00 an hour and for paid family leave, and says housing is a human right that should be affordable and accessible to everyone.
economy.short: Supports raising minimum wage to $15, paid family leave, affordable housing.

taxes.summary: His campaign platform proposes altering the wage tax for tipped employees so that employers are responsible for paying it.
taxes.short: Proposes shifting tipped-employee wage tax responsibility onto employers.

abortion.summary: His campaign platform supports granting free access to high quality, trauma informed, and culturally competent reproductive health and abortion services for working class communities across the commonwealth.
abortion.short: Supports free access to reproductive health and abortion services.

education.summary: His campaign platform supports universal Pre-K, free community college, and increased funding for career and technical education, and opposes tying school funding to standardized test scores.
education.short: Supports universal Pre-K, free community college; opposes test-based school funding.

healthcare.summary: His campaign platform supports creating a public healthcare option to ensure every Pennsylvanian has access to quality healthcare regardless of income or employment, and increased funding for community mental health resources.
healthcare.short: Supports a public healthcare option and community mental health funding.

energy.summary: His campaign platform, under environmental justice, supports a state law incentivizing residents to install solar panels, funding to combat flooding, and the creation of new green jobs.
energy.short: Supports solar incentives, flood funding, and new green jobs.

guns.summary: His campaign platform does not state a position on firearms; its public safety content appears in a criminal justice section supporting an end to mandatory minimum sentencing, universal parole, and marijuana legalization with expungement.
guns.short: No firearms position stated; platform focuses on criminal justice reform.
